adversarial_audit.objection: Orbit-adaptive syndrome KL also needs to be o(1).
adversarial_audit.resolution: Not for the sublogarithmic rank-transfer gate; it is uniformly bounded by three bits.

adversarial_audit.objection: The three-bit term can grow logarithmically through conditioning.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Conditional KL to uniform on eight outcomes is pointwise at most three bits, so averaging cannot increase it.

adversarial_audit.objection: Coarse sign orbits are an ad hoc quotient.
adversarial_audit.resolution: They are exactly merged A_n irreducible labels with the matching coarse Plancherel law.

adversarial_audit.objection: Rank mixing would eliminate all syndrome information.
adversarial_audit.resolution: The non-Haar conditional cumulants can carry a bounded survivor outside every rank-compatible Markov model.

claim_gate.reason: The entropy gate now lies entirely in the coarse A_n base law, whose all-n total correlation remains unbounded.

falsifiers_triggered: The bounded three-bit orientation channel cannot obstruct a sublogarithmic rank-transfer theorem.
The remaining base entropy is a standard alternating-group law, not an arbitrary quotient.
Rank-profile mixing would not by itself eliminate irreducible Racah syndrome information.

proof_obligations.resolution: The sufficient orientation statistic has only eight outcomes, so its conditional KL is at most three bits.
Sign-orbit averaging restricts all three word inputs to A_n and the coarse weights are A_n Plancherel weights.
Prove D(P_coarse-A_n||Q_coarse-A_n)=o(log n), or construct a logarithmic positive-mass obstruction.
A bounded three-bit term is harmless for rank transfer but may remain the only non-Haar measured-label survivor.

summary: Reduced the sublogarithmic physical rank-transfer condition exactly to the coarse A_n tetrahedral base-label total correlation.

theorem.alternating_group_identification: D_base is the total correlation of the coarse A_n tetrahedral weak-Fourier label law relative to coarse A_n Plancherel product
theorem.rank_transfer_implication: D_base=o(log n) implies physical Haar rank-profile mixing

theorem_contract.base_law: D_base is the total correlation of the coarse A_n tetrahedral weak-Fourier label law relative to coarse A_n Plancherel product
theorem_contract.rank_consequence: D_base=o(log n) implies physical Haar rank-profile mixing
theorem_contract.scope: No asymptotic entropy bound for the coarse A_n law and no non-Haar Racah-syndrome conclusion is proved.
